summary: The hashicorp.vault.kv2_secret_get lookup reads KV2 secrets, replacing community.hashi_vault.hashi_vault and the vault_kv2_get lookup. Parameters: auth_method (default token), mount_point (alias secret_mount_path), namespace (default admin), required secret in path[:field] format, required url, and version (latest if unset); most map one to one.
questions: What lookup replaces community.hashi_vault.hashi_vault for KV2?
How do I get one field of a KV2 secret with a lookup?
Which kv2_secret_get parameters map to community.hashi_vault?
